# GRL®

> Phone cases for women who treat their phone as fashion.

GRL® (GRLHOOD) is an Indian D2C brand making aesthetic, protective phone cases. Designed mood-first — protection is guaranteed, aesthetics are non-negotiable.

## Products

- Aesthetic phone cases for iPhone and Samsung
- Case types: Tough Cases, Glass Cases, Clear Cases, Grip Cases, Silicone Cases
- Collections: Wild, Amore, Coquette, Dead Pretty, Glaze, Cloud, Crown, Player
- Price range: ₹299 — ₹1,499
